title.narrative: Construction and equipping of Dr. Abdul Razzaq bin Muhammad Al-Saleh Health Center in Al-Saleem Village, Section 3, East North, Dongola Locality, Northern State, Republic of Sudan

description.narrative: A health center prepared to provide treatment services to the residents of the Al-Saleem area, Section 3, East North, and the neighboring villages. The center is ready to receive medical cases and provide treatment services to provide its services to a number of (12,000) beneficiaries.

Construction, preparation and equipping of a health center to provide free primary health care, which consists of: a family medicine clinic, a treatment room, a men’s observation room, a women’s observation room, a pharmacy, a laboratory, reception, archives, files and monitoring, waiting rooms for men and women, a small operating room, and restrooms, in order to provide urgent diagnostic and therapeutic services to all segments of the population in the village of Al-Saleem, Section (3) Northeast, and the neighboring villages and those displaced to the region due to the crisis.

Providing health services for the residents of Al-Saleem District, Section (3) North East, and the surrounding areas by constructing an integrated health center, furnishing it with appropriate furniture, and providing sufficient medical equipment and devices to cover the needs of the residents in health aspects, confront challenges, provide them with first aid, meet their need for family medicine services in their area, limit their travel to other areas, reduce the number of patients who do not currently find health services due to their lack and unavailability in the area, and early detection of chronic diseases before they become severe and reduce deaths due to that.
